verdict.rationale: Docs show agent-originated orders flow through standard Stripe rails: checkout.session.completed events, Dashboard Transactions tagged and filterable by agent, bulk fulfillment, and machine-payment settlement described as landing in the standard Stripe balance with 'metrics, reporting, and multi-currency payouts work the same as any other payment in Stripe,' plus standard Refunds API support. However, the agent_details attribution field is explicitly 'Private preview,' ACS itself is gated to private preview/select countries, and community feedback (comm-10) notes the SPT/MPP end-to-end object mapping documentation is 'very sparse,' with no independent hands-on reconciliation report to corroborate the first-party claims. Missing for 10: GA (non-preview) attribution fields, independent/third-party confirmation of actual payout reconciliation workflows, and clearer end-to-end object-level documentation.
